wallOfThoughts.author: Sprout_902
wallOfThoughts.content: To whoever is studying at 3 AM crying over syllabus: Your worth is not defined by one semester. Drink some water and breathe.

wallOfThoughts.author: Amber_17 (Peer)
wallOfThoughts.content: If all you did today was get out of bed and brush your teeth, that was enough. You are surviving, and that takes courage.

wallOfThoughts.author: Dr. Priya M. (Counselor)
wallOfThoughts.content: Notice 5 things you can see around you right now. 4 things you can touch. You are grounded in this exact moment, and you are safe.
